Object Removal Case Study · Qwen Image 3.0

A showcase of mask-guided object removal using Qwen Image 3.0. The white region of the mask image indicates the object to remove.

Prompt

Image 1 is the base edit image. Image 2 is a binary mask. The white pixels in Image 2 define the exact region to remove from Image 1. Delete only that region. Restore it with a seamless continuation of the rocky summit, forest, lake, and sky visible around the masked area. Keep all other hikers, rocks, trees, water, and landscape features in Image 1 exactly as they are. Do not move remaining objects. Do not add new objects. Do not alter the background, lighting, or colors.
